::: {#rem-energy}

#### What sweeps cost

A sweep multiplies the cost of training by the number of trials.
@strubell2019energy add up one research project that ran 123 small hyperparameter grid searches,
4,789 training runs in all,
which used 27 GPU-years over six months.
They recommend that papers report training time and how sensitive a model is to its hyperparameters [@strubell2019energy, section 5],
so that readers can weigh what a result cost.
@patterson2021carbon find that the choice of model,
datacenter and processor can change the carbon footprint of training by up to 100 to 1,000 times.
[Running Deep Learning Experiments](dl-experiments.qmd) shows how to plan a sweep so that each trial answers a question.

:::
